title: Create a Scene from a Template

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0058 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-24 directive to complete the Template-creation node. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0058.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-24 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0057 recorded that Template-based Scene creation was deferred; the Studio Scenes surface offered only blank Scene creation, so AC-006's 'chooses blank or a Template' branch was unmet.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue before this change and CHG-0057 deferred unknown.

claims.statement: The fix adds built-in Scene templates and a New Scene chooser to the Scenes surface; choosing a Template creates a Scene pre-populated with the Template's elements through the create endpoint's scene body and opens the Editor, while Blank remains available.

Governed discovery reordered the node: because the create endpoint accepts a scene body (CHG-0055) and the New Scene control is already wired (CHG-0056), the Template branch is a Studio chooser plus a built-in Template, not a new server feature.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-24, CHG-0055 and CHG-0056.

claims.statement: Offering a Template chooser and asserting a Template-created Scene carries the Template's elements rather than a blank canvas proves AC-006's Template branch at the browser tier.

Human review accepted CHG-0058: the Studio Scenes surface offers a New Scene chooser with Blank and built-in Templates, and choosing a Template creates a Scene pre-populated with its elements and opens the Editor (AC-006 Template branch), proven in a real browser. A user-managed Template library stays deferred.
claims.evidence: studio/src/sceneTemplates.ts, studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue, server/tests/e2e/studioSceneTemplate.test.ts, the passing Studio unit suite and full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0058 pull-request Constitution run, and human acceptance on 2026-08-24.

claims.statement: The change is a Studio-only edit (a built-in Template list and a Scenes-surface chooser); no server or protocol behavior changes.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0058 branch and the pull-request validate job.

claims.statement: The built-in Scene templates are a small starter set; a user-managed Template library is deferred and belongs to the Library acceptance criteria (AC-009).
claims.evidence: studio/src/sceneTemplates.ts is a fixed built-in list.

successCriteria.statement: The Scenes surface offers Blank and at least one Template; choosing a Template creates a Scene pre-populated with its elements and opens the Editor.
successCriteria.verification: Browser harness opens the New Scene chooser, picks the Lower Third Template, asserts the Editor edit route, and asserts the created Scene lists the Template's elements.

successCriteria.statement: Choosing Blank still creates a blank Scene and opens the Editor.
successCriteria.verification: The Studio New Scene browser test picks Blank and asserts the edit route and the created Scene.

successCriteria.statement: No existing Studio or server behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: The Studio unit suite and the full server suite pass.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0058 records the Template chooser and the deferred user-managed Template library before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The Scenes surface offers built-in Templates and the create endpoint's scene body carries the Template content.
A browser test proves a Template-created Scene carries the Template's elements and the blank flow still works; the Studio unit suite and full server suite pass.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, vue-tsc and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
